_readme: Copy to customer.config.json (git-ignored, or point CUSTOMER_CONFIG at it) to brand a run. name and tagline are the page title and subtitle. vertical is retail, health or finance. cast renames the people and things the stories talk about; agentId is lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Everything else is ignored.
